# Paw Weather: Dog Walk Tracker

> An iPhone dog walk app: it estimates pavement temperature from your local forecast and gives a GO / CAUTION / DANGER verdict for paw burns and heatstroke, warns about ice, frostbite and road salt in winter, and logs your dog's walks and care.

## What it does

- Estimates asphalt and concrete temperature from the forecast, including heat the pavement stores into the evening
- Judges two dangers separately — hot pavement (paw pads) and heat (heatstroke risk) — and names which one tripped the verdict
- Hour-by-hour bar for the day showing safe walk windows
- Winter warnings: frostbite risk on bare paws, wind chill, road salt conditions
- Records walks with the route, a care log (meals, potty, weight and more) and care plans with reminders
- Learn articles, including the 7-second hand test
- Paw Weather Pro (in-app purchase): 7-day walk planner, smart alerts, more dogs
- Weather data: U.S. National Weather Service in the United States, MET Norway elsewhere
- No account; an educational planning tool, not veterinary advice

## Who it's for

- Dog owners who want to know whether it is too hot (or too icy) to walk the dog right now, and when it will be OK
- Owners of puppies, seniors and heat-sensitive breeds
